in_marathi.name: Muktikanta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Liberation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Muktikanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Muktikanta is a Sanskrit name which is derived from the word Mukti, meaning liberation. This name is given to a child who is believed to bring freedom, salvation and liberation to those around him. It is a name of great significance in Hinduism, particularly in the mythology surrounding Vishnu and his avatars.
